contract.intent: Rewrite lock! to a thin named-artifact record: lock! <id> <name> <path> [type] verifies the path exists, hashes the raw file, derives the version from the log, and records the artifact-locked event — never writing, copying, stamping, or symlinking the file. gate! accept persists the rationale. read returns verbatim content, marker-tolerant for legacy files.
acceptanceCriteria: lock() takes an explicit project-relative path that must exist; records {name, path, lockSha, type?, version?}
place() and workingFile() are deleted; no marker stamp is written; no docs/ symlink is created; any file type is lockable
gate() accept event carries feedback (G1); reject unchanged
read() returns verbatim content; stripMarkers retained as a read-time no-op for legacy stamped files
return shape keeps {name, path, contentPath, sha} with contentPath equal to the recorded path (flow tests depend on it)
